definitions.explanation: Fat stored in the body. Commonly discussed in health, fitness, and medical contexts, especially in relation to body fat percentage.

examples.japanese: {体脂肪|たいしぼう}を{減|へ}らす。
{体脂肪|たいしぼう}{率|りつ}を{毎月|まいつき}{測|はか}っている。
examples.english: I measure my body fat percentage every month.

examples.japanese: {運動|うんどう}を{続|つづ}けたら、{体脂肪|たいしぼう}が{大|おお}きく{下|さ}がって{健康|けんこう}{診断|しんだん}の{結果|けっか}もよくなった。
examples.english: After continuing to exercise, my body fat dropped significantly and my health checkup results improved too.

notes: Common collocations: {体脂肪|たいしぼう}{率|りつ} (body fat percentage), {体脂肪|たいしぼう}を{減|へ}らす (to reduce body fat), {体脂肪|たいしぼう}を{落|お}とす (to drop body fat), {体脂肪|たいしぼう}{計|けい} (body fat monitor/scale). Related: {脂肪|しぼう} (fat — general), {内臓|ないぞう}{脂肪|しぼう} (visceral fat), {皮下|ひか}{脂肪|しぼう} (subcutaneous fat).
